assertions.name: free_word_has_two_cycles_per_nucleon
assertions.source: cycle count of the ordered product of transpositions s_g over atom_braid_word_3A(include_inter=False), vs 2A, for A = 2..20 (18 isotopes). Computed from the WORD -- no Hecke trace, no q-dependence: every letter's d coefficient is 0, -h or -h/2 and vanishes at q = 1.

assertions.name: atom_word_cycle_count_is_A_plus_one
assertions.source: same computation with include_inter=True, vs A+1, over the same isotopes

assertions.name: each_inter_nucleon_interface_merges_exactly_one_cycle_pair
assertions.source: c(free) - c(atom) vs A-1 over the same isotopes. This is the same (A-1)-bond chain adjacency derive_binding_chain_cooperative sums over, arrived at from the permutation rather than from the interface list -- so the floor's A-dependence IS the chain structure.

assertions.name: markov_trace_at_q_one_is_two_to_the_cycle_count_minus_n
assertions.source: worst relative error between the Richardson q -> 1 limit of tr_m_atom_zn (transfer kernel over all partitions) and 2^(c - n) with c from the permutation count. Two entirely separate computations. This is the Schur-Weyl step: sum_lambda dim(V_lambda) chi^lambda(sigma) = 2^c(sigma), the character of sigma permuting the factors of (C^2)^{tensor n}. Residuals are extrapolation error and grow with A.

assertions.name: closed_form_follows_from_the_cycle_counts_exactly
assertions.source: 2^(c_free - 3A) - 2^(c_atom - 3A) with the MEASURED cycle counts, vs 2^-A - 2^(1-2A), for A = 2..20 at 60 dps. Exact, not extrapolated: this is step 3 of the derivation and it is pure arithmetic once steps 1 and 2 hold.

description: Derives the classical floor of tr_M(W_free) - tr_M(W_atom) instead of extrapolating it: Schur-Weyl at q=1 gives tr_M = 2^(c(sigma)-n), and the cycle counts read straight off the braid words are c_free = 2A, c_atom = A+1, so c0(A) = 2^-A - 2^(1-2A) exactly, for every A -- including where the trace itself is not computable.

derivation.step_1: tr_M(beta)|_{q=1} = 2^(c(sigma_beta) - n). y_lambda = s_lambda(1,Q)/(1+Q)^n and at Q=1 s_lambda(1,1) = dim V_lambda^{GL(2)} = lambda_1 - lambda_2 + 1, zero for l(lambda) > 2 (the row cap). Schur-Weyl then gives sum_lambda dim(V_lambda) chi^lambda(sigma) = character of sigma on (C^2)^{tensor n} = 2^{c(sigma)}, since sigma fixes exactly the basis vectors constant on each cycle.
derivation.step_2: c(sigma_free) = 2A, c(sigma_atom) = A+1, and c_free - c_atom = A-1: each of the A-1 inter-nucleon interfaces merges one pair of cycles. Every letter's d coefficient vanishes at q=1, so the word degenerates to a product of transpositions and the count is q-independent.
derivation.scope: exact for every A -- the cycle count costs nothing, so this holds far past A = 5 where the Markov trace stops being computable.

classical_contamination_dies_exponential.asymptotics: c0(A) ~ 2^-A, so the share falls by roughly a factor of 2 per nucleon while Delta_tr(q0) grows. Measured 22.46 % at the deuteron and 4.88 % at 4He.
classical_contamination_dies_exponential.consequence: the floor is a LIGHT-nucleus contaminant. The deuteron's apparent agreement under convention A was floor-driven (qou-zrx2); the 4He 4-body alpha-residual story is essentially untouched by the subtraction.

data.what_is_still_not_formal: Step 1 uses Schur-Weyl duality, which Mathlib does not have (no Specht/GL-duality development). Steps 2 and 3 are finite combinatorics and arithmetic and are Lean-sized: 'the ordered product of these transpositions has A+1 cycles' and '2^(2A-3A) - 2^((A+1)-3A) = 2^-A - 2^(1-2A)'. So a Lean statement would carry Schur-Weyl as a hypothesis class and prove the rest -- the honest split, since assuming step 1 assumes a published theorem while steps 2-3 would be genuinely derived.
data.verdict: c0(A) = 2^-A - 2^(1-2A) is DERIVED, not fitted. tr_M at q=1 is 2^(c-n) by Schur-Weyl (checked against the transfer kernel to 1e-7 at five isotopes), and the cycle counts c_free = 2A, c_atom = A+1 come straight off the braid words for A = 2..20 with no trace evaluation. c_free - c_atom = A-1 recovers the corpus's own chain adjacency from the permutation, so the floor's A-dependence IS the chain. qou-zrx2's finding no longer rests on an extrapolation.
